game_title: Function Test Arena – Northern Wall Race
game_concept: A racing platformer set in Snowy Hold – Northern Wall, the northern wall: the innkeeper must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Test Arena: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing blizzard sprites.
theme: Snowy Hold – Northern Wall: the northern wall
core_gameplay_loop: In Northern Wall, repeat each round: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing blizzard sprites. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the innkeeper ahead. Then check the tests_passed value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the watch bell by solving code steps involving tests_passed that move the innkeeper forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the watch bell first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 7 (applied tier): Function Test Arena
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Function Test Arena' (Week 6 slot 13), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Northern Wall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tests_passed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against blizzard sprites in Northern Wall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
